messages.en: I just wanted to ask, have you eaten yet?
Not yet. Where do you want to eat?

senses.en_definition: All at once; at the same time or in a single action.

collocations.en: pay in full in one go

senses.en_definition: Together with others; included or accompanying as well.
Very; extremely, used after an adjective for emphasis.
Once; on a certain occasion, used in traditional storytelling.

messages.en: I'm going to the shop to get some bread. Want to come along?
Yeah! Hang on, let me grab my wallet first.

senses.en_definition: Now; at the present moment or during the current period.

messages.en: I'm heading out now. Are you ready?
Not yet. Give me five more minutes. Just wait downstairs for me.
Okay, I'll text you when I get there.

senses.en_definition: For a moment; for a short time.
Soon; in a short while, especially when followed by lagi.

messages.en: Hang on, let me grab my keys. I'm just about to come down.
Okay, I'll just wait in the car. It's hot outside.
